sections.title: Who these terms cover
sections.text: These terms cover the Lazo websites, account service, Pencil and Power Chords, provided by Saurabh Misal under the name Lazo. You must be at least 18 and able to enter a contract, or have authority to act for your organisation. Contact support@lazo.tools about these terms.

sections.text: You retain ownership of your notes, documents and other content. You are responsible for choosing what to save, keeping your recovery password and credentials secure, and maintaining independent, tested backups before installation, updates, imports, migrations or deletion. Keep a separate backup; local storage alone cannot protect against device loss or failure. Browser data can be cleared, devices can fail and lost keys may make encrypted data unrecoverable. Do not use a preview as the only copy of important work.

You remain responsible for decisions and for actions you authorise, including code execution, file changes and communications. Use qualified professional advice where needed and keep safety-critical work under appropriate human control. No outcome, accuracy, uninterrupted service or recovery of lost content is promised.
